reference_sql:
WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product and price version, with the list price of the version before it
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), rises AS (
  -- one row per price rise from 1 to 28 February 2025 of a product on sale for its whole before window
  SELECT v.product_id, v.valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', v.valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week, p.category_id
  FROM versions v
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id
  WHERE v.list_price_eur > v.prev_price
    AND v.valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
    AND p.launch_date <= CAST(date_trunc('week', v.valid_from) AS DATE) - INTERVAL 56 DAY
), windows AS (
  -- one row per price rise: its units before and after
  SELECT r.category_id, r.product_id, r.valid_from,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start < r.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) AS units_before,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start > r.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) AS units_after
  FROM rises r
  JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = r.product_id
    AND w.week_start BETWEEN r.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AND r.change_week + INTERVAL 56 DAY
  GROUP BY r.category_id, r.product_id, r.valid_from
)
SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS rises, SUM(units_before) AS units_before, SUM(units_after) AS units_after,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(units_after) - SUM(units_before)) / NULLIF(SUM(units_before), 0), 1) AS pct_change
FROM windows
GROUP BY category_id

WITH versions AS (
  -- one row per product and price version, with the list price of the version before it
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), rises AS (
  -- one row per price rise from 1 to 28 February 2025, with the Monday of its week
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week
  FROM versions
  WHERE list_price_eur > prev_price AND valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
), kept AS (
  -- one row per price rise of a product on sale for its whole before window
  SELECT r.product_id, r.valid_from, r.change_week, p.category_id
  FROM rises r
  JOIN products p ON p.product_id = r.product_id
  WHERE p.launch_date <= r.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY
), totals AS (
  -- one row per category: its rises and their units before and after
  SELECT k.category_id, COUNT(DISTINCT k.product_id || '-' || CAST(k.valid_from AS VARCHAR)) AS rises,
    SUM(w.units) FILTER (WHERE w.week_start < k.change_week) AS units_before,
    SUM(w.units) FILTER (WHERE w.week_start > k.change_week) AS units_after
  FROM kept k
  JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = k.product_id
    AND w.week_start BETWEEN k.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AND k.change_week + INTERVAL 56 DAY
  GROUP BY k.category_id
)
SELECT category_id, rises, units_before, units_after,
  ROUND(100.0 * (units_after - units_before) / NULLIF(units_before, 0), 1) AS pct_change
FROM totals

solver.query:
WITH versions AS (
  SELECT product_id, valid_from, list_price_eur,
    LAG(list_price_eur) OVER (PARTITION BY product_id ORDER BY valid_from) AS prev_price
  FROM price_history
), rises AS (
  SELECT v.product_id, p.category_id, v.valid_from, CAST(date_trunc('week', v.valid_from) AS DATE) AS change_week
  FROM versions v JOIN products p ON p.product_id = v.product_id
  WHERE v.list_price_eur > v.prev_price AND v.valid_from BETWEEN DATE '2025-02-01' AND DATE '2025-02-28'
    AND NOT (p.launch_date > CAST(date_trunc('week', v.valid_from) AS DATE) - INTERVAL 56 DAY)
), agg AS (
  SELECT r.category_id, r.product_id, r.valid_from,
    SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start < r.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) AS units_before,
  SUM(CASE WHEN w.week_start > r.change_week THEN w.units ELSE 0 END) AS units_after
  FROM rises r JOIN weekly_units w ON w.product_id = r.product_id
  AND w.week_start BETWEEN CAST(r.change_week - INTERVAL 56 DAY AS DATE) AND CAST(r.change_week + INTERVAL 56 DAY AS DATE)
  GROUP BY r.category_id, r.product_id, r.valid_from
)
SELECT category_id, COUNT(*) AS rises, SUM(units_before) AS units_before, SUM(units_after) AS units_after,
  ROUND(100.0 * (SUM(units_after) - SUM(units_before)) / NULLIF(SUM(units_before), 0), 1) AS pct_change
FROM agg GROUP BY category_id
